items.question: What is AI agent authority?
items.title: What Is AI Agent Authority? | Cyber Sentinels
items.meta_description: Learn how AI agent identity differs from delegated authority, and why permission must match each action, purpose and policy.

items.question: Why do AI agents need Zero Trust execution controls?
items.title: Zero Trust Execution Controls for AI Agents
items.meta_description: See why agent actions need current, least-privilege authorization at the point of execution—not only a one-time identity check.

items.question: What happens when an AI agent acts without permission?
items.title: When an AI Agent Acts Without Permission
items.meta_description: A practical response starts by containing the action, preserving evidence, checking downstream effects and restoring appropriate authority.

items.question: How is AI agent identity different from AI agent authority?
items.title: AI Agent Identity vs Authority
items.meta_description: Identity answers who or what is acting; authority answers which actions are permitted, for what purpose and under which policy.

items.question: Who authorizes an AI agent's MCP tool call?
items.title: MCP Security: Who Authorises the Tool Call?
items.meta_description: MCP tool availability is not action authority. Learn the questions teams should answer before an agent can affect a target.

items.question: How do evidence, receipts and Replay support AI accountability?
items.title: Evidence and Replay for AI Accountability
items.meta_description: Understand how decision evidence can help teams review an AI action without confusing an authorization record with proof of execution.

items.question: How can an organisation contain an autonomous agent swarm?
items.title: How to Contain an Autonomous Agent Swarm
items.meta_description: Plan layered containment around authority, tool boundaries, provider credentials, evidence and tested human response—not a promised remote kill switch.

items.question: What is the story behind Cyber Sentinels and TENENTE?
items.title: Cyber Sentinels and TENENTE: Our Story
items.meta_description: Built in Aragón, the TENENTE story connects watchfulness, guardianship and the need for accountable authority in an agentic world.
